title: Installation of the Cabin Floor Proximity Escape Path Marking
abstract: Installation of the cabin floor proximity escape path marking, with the photometric check and the twelve-minute autonomy check that certify the installation before the aircraft returns to service.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the cabin floor proximity escape path marking and to do the photometric and autonomy checks required before the aircraft is released to service.
sections.job_setup_note: The channel must be clean and the channel lip must be undamaged along its full length. Confirm the marking standard against the aircraft configuration before you start: the photoluminescent strip and the light-emitting diode strip use the same channel but different marker assemblies, and the two must never be mixed on one aisle. Have the photometric test set calibrated within its due date; an out-of-date set invalidates the check.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm the marking standard against the aircraft configuration. 2. Clean the channel and do a detailed visual inspection of the channel lip. 3. Install the lining panel D3320007009192 with the tubular spacers AES27771-7A. 4. Lay the strip in the channel working forward to aft and engage the retaining lip at every seat row. CAUTION: DO NOT STRETCH THE STRIP TO REACH THE NEXT STATION. A STRETCHED STRIP WILL PULL OUT OF THE CHANNEL IN SERVICE. 5. Install the exit marker assembly D3320137300785 at each exit and connect it. 6. Install the lens at the exit panel 841LP7 and at the inboard stowage marker 850LP6. 7. Connect the strip at each cabin station. 8. Energise the emergency lighting system and restore the distributed battery units. 9. Do the emergency lighting functional test. 10. Do the photometric check at the positions given in the illustration. 11. Do the twelve-minute autonomy check with the aircraft on battery only. WARNING: DO NOT RELEASE THE AIRCRAFT TO SERVICE IF THE AUTONOMY CHECK IS NOT SATISFACTORY. THE ESCAPE PATH MARKING IS A CERTIFICATION ITEM. 12. Lay the aisle carpet back and install the cabin seats.
sections.close_out: Record the photometric readings and the autonomy check result on the aircraft work card. Remove the charge time placards if the aircraft has moved from the photoluminescent to the light-emitting diode standard. Do a general visual inspection of both aisles with the cabin lights off. Confirm the seat locking check before the aircraft returns to service.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Post MOD-164122 aircraft need the twelve-minute autonomy check; aircraft at the photoluminescent standard need the charge time check instead.

safety_precautions: Keep the emergency lighting de-energised until step 8.
Use only a calibrated photometric test set.
Do not mix marking standards on one aisle.
